findings.claim: The original 00421df0 rasterizer executed through Ghidra x86 P-code with the original 00409210 classifier and synthetic terrain-service thunks; in an aligned case mode 2 yielded 7 height/material writes and mode 4 yielded 3 material-only writes.
findings.limitations: Counts are for a fixed synthetic grid and section scalar; original TERRAIN/zone services were substituted, and Ghidra x87 P-code does not guarantee hardware-equivalent boundary rounding.

findings.claim: With an existing valid height at exactly one qualifying cell, original mode-2 raster instructions reduced height/material writes from 7 to 6; original mode 4 reduced material writes from 3 to 2, confirming local sentinel precedence under original control flow.
findings.limitations: Synthetic terrain callback returned height 777 at one coordinate and 0x8000 elsewhere; no authentic editable .I76 input.

findings.claim: Executing original 00421be0 neighbor repair within 00421df0 mode 3 with persistent synthetic terrain services propagated one valid 600 height into 25 new cells during the same sweep, because later native helper calls observe earlier writes.
findings.limitations: Effect is experimentally established only for the documented synthetic terrain map and emulator environment; native terrain services and cross-zone addressing were substituted.

findings.claim: In original 00421be0 execution mode 5, valid height 600 with material 6 preserved the seeded cell, while the same seed with material 0 was repainted road material 2; zero terrain heights were written in either mode-5 experiment.
findings.limitations: Synthetic terrain service map; other original terrain writers and full render/export passes not present.

findings.claim: Original modes 4/5 read a local stack float at 00422127 and 004221A3 where the native local path did not identify an initializing assignment; EmulatorHelper warned for the unset slot, but deliberately perturbing its initial value did not change examined simple road write sets.
findings.limitations: No demonstration of an observable original retail defect or full caller stack/lifetime reconstruction; x87 emulation discrepancies remain. Do not label this a proven bug.
